Motivation Monday (Bonafide CC)

Atlanta, GA · Inman Park · Road

Beginner friendly

Motivation Monday (Bonafide CC) is a road group ride in Atlanta, GA. It rolls every Monday at 6:15 pm from Inman Park MARTA Station. About 20+ miles, beginner-friendly, lower elevation.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner-friendly, lower elevation.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Motivation Monday (Bonafide CC) group ride

Bonafide's easiest weeknight ride. Twenty-plus miles on the flatter side of town, aimed at people newer to group riding. Helmet and front and rear lights required. Meets at the Inman Park train station.
